title: Free Crypto Airdrops: What They Are and How Scammers Fake Them
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. An airdrop is a project giving free tokens to users, but scammers copy the idea to steal wallets. Sources: Investopedia, Coinbase Learn. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: FREE CRYPTO?
scenes.narration: Free crypto sounds great. Projects really do give away tokens, and this is called an airdrop. But scammers love the idea too.

scenes.head: WHAT IS AN AIRDROP?
scenes.narration: In a real airdrop, a project sends free tokens to wallets, often to early users, to build attention and a community.

scenes.head: THE FAKE VERSION
scenes.narration: Scammers send fake links and messages pretending to be an airdrop, hoping you will connect your wallet or share secrets.

scenes.head: 3 RED FLAGS
scenes.narration: Red flags include asking for your seed phrase, pressure to hurry, and surprise tokens from a sender you do not know.

scenes.head: HOW SAFE USERS ACT
scenes.narration: Safer habits are using only official websites, never sharing your seed phrase, and ignoring links from strangers.

scenes.head: EDUCATION, NOT ADVICE
scenes.sub: IF IT SOUNDS TOO EASY, PAUSE
scenes.narration: If something sounds too easy, pause and check it. This is education, not advice.
